snippet.title: Conrad Riker
snippet.description:
As a writer and advocate, my journey has been shaped by the conviction that men deserve fairness, dignity, and respect in every facet of their lives. The civil rights movement for men is not about division or hostility; it's about confronting a system that has grown increasingly indifferent to the struggles of men, particularly in divorce, family law, and societal expectations.

My motivation stems from the countless stories of hardworking men who have been left devastated by a legal framework designed to strip them of their rights. These men, many of whom have built their lives on the foundation of sacrifice and responsibility, find themselves battling a system that does not value their contributions as fathers, providers, or individuals. 

I write not out of bitterness, but out of a desire for balance and fairness—a belief that every individual, regardless of gender, deserves justice and the opportunity to thrive. Together, we can change the narrative.

snippet.title: Sobrevivência Alfa
snippet.description:
Sobrevivência Alfa canal dedicado à arte da sobrevivência e preparação para emergências! Aqui, você encontra estratégias práticas, dicas essenciais e orientações inteligentes para estar pronto diante de qualquer desafio, seja em cenários de sobrevivência urbana, desastres naturais, crises econômicas, apagões, ou aventuras ao ar livre.

Acreditamos que sobrevivência consciente não é apenas acumular itens em um estoque ou ter um kit de emergência — é também desenvolver uma mentalidade resiliente, treinar habilidades de autossuficiência, e estar atento às mudanças no mundo ao nosso redor.
Venha conosco e aprenda a viver de forma segura, consciente e preparada em qualquer situação. Este é um espaço para quem leva sobrevivência a sério, mas também quer aplicar esses aprendizados no dia a dia.

snippet.title: Mike Pfeiffer - LLOD
snippet.description:
(Artist formerly known as Last Line of Defense) I'm into gear and good times - most of my videos revolve around those and general preparedness. I like to spend a lot of my free time in the outdoors, and I live in Colorado up in the Rocky Mountains. In this period of my life, a lot of my time is spent in the backwoods 'overlanding' or 'offroading', but mostly I just like to call it 'camping'. I do a lot of real world, practical, functional testing of gear out camping, overlanding, etc - so I can relay that information back to you guys, when you're looking for more than just stats that you can read off a webpage.

Many products reviewed on this channel have been kindly donated from various companies for my personal, unbiased feedback. If you think you have a product that might be of interest to me or my channel, I'd love to hear about it - shoot me an email at mike@llod.us
